title: ome-isvc chart values
description: Scientist-facing schema for charts/ome-isvc/values.yaml. The chart bundles N InferenceService stacks per release; SRE-y concerns (resources, tolerations, RDMA, volumes) are hidden in the vendor ClusterServingRuntime profiles under templates/vendors/.

nameOverride.description: Override the chart name component of release-derived names.

fullnameOverride.description: Pin the exact release-name prefix; bypasses release-name composition.

name.description: Namespace the InferenceService(s) land in. Must already exist; chart does not create it.

scope.description: Tenant child runtime scope (cluster -> ClusterServingRuntime; namespace -> ServingRuntime). Vendor runtimes under templates/vendors/ are always cluster-scoped regardless.

vendor.description: Default vendor profile inherited by deployments that omit `vendor:`. Must match a profile bundled under templates/vendors/.

deployments.description: One or more model-serving stacks. Each entry produces one InferenceService + one tenant child ClusterServingRuntime.

name.description: Short identifier; becomes <release>-<name> for the InferenceService and <release>-<name>-csr for the tenant child ClusterServingRuntime.

vendor.description: Vendor ClusterServingRuntime name the tenant child runtime inherits from via the ome.io/inherit-from annotation. Optional: defaults to .Values.vendor. Must match a profile bundled under templates/vendors/.

servingMode.description: standalone = single engine component; pd = prefill+decode disaggregated (prefill + decode, plus optional router); multinode = single engine with leader/worker gang.

modelRef.description: Reference to a (Cluster)BaseModel already on the cluster (or created inline via the top-level basemodels list).

deployAll.description: When true, emit EVERY bundled vendor ClusterServingRuntime. When false (default), emit only vendor runtimes referenced by some entry in deployments[].vendor.

basemodels.description: Optional inline (Cluster)BaseModel(s). Empty by default — most deployments reference a model that already exists on the cluster. Scientists only need `name` and `storageUri`; everything else is optional and inferred by the OME controller.

storageUri.description: Source URI of the model in a supported storage backend (oci://, hf://, s3://, gs://, az://, github://, ...). Required.

vendor.description: Optional vendor label on the BaseModel. Omitted from the rendered resource when unset.

distribution.description: Optional distribution mode (e.g. Sharded). Omitted when unset; controller chooses based on model size.

displayName.description: Optional human-friendly display name. Omitted when unset; controller derives from `name`.

metrics.description: Placeholder for the KEDA metrics surface; see chart README open work items.

speculativeBlock.description: Speculative decoding knobs. The `algorithm` field GATES the whole block — if empty/unset, none of the speculative-* flags emit even if a draftModelPath is set.

algorithm.description: Speculative algorithm (e.g. EAGLE, EAGLE3). Empty string disables the whole block (gating field). Synthesised as `--speculative-algorithm <value>`.

draftModelPath.description: Path to the draft model on disk (e.g. `$(MODEL_PATH)/draft_hf`). Emits `--speculative-draft-model <value>` only when `algorithm` is set.

draftModelQuantization.description: Quantization scheme for the draft model (e.g. `unquant`). Emits `--speculative-draft-model-quantization <value>` only when `algorithm` is set.

lifecycleBlock.description: OMENative lifecycle overrides. STRICT pass-through: chart never defaults a field; the controller's defaulter stamps the canonical defaults (SurgeThenDrain, instanceReadyTimeout=30m, etc.). Mirrors pkg/apis/ome/v1beta1/lifecycle_types.go::LifecycleSpec. Every sub-key is optional; the chart emits a sub-tree only when at least one of its leaves is set.

restartPolicy.description: What OMENative does when a managed pod fails. Distinct from corev1.PodSpec.restartPolicy (which tells kubelet about container-level restarts).

updateStrategy.description: How OMENative rolls template changes across the Component's Instances.

type.description: Rollout mechanism. Controller default is SurgeThenDrain (preserves serving capacity).

partition.description: Hold back updates for Instances whose index is < partition. 0 updates all.

maxUnavailable.description: Max Instances allowed to be non-Ready during the rollout.

maxSurge.description: Max extra Instances created above desired during the rollout.

gracePeriodSeconds.description: Accepted so existing values keep validating; has no effect on the roll. Draining is the pod's own terminationGracePeriodSeconds and preStop.

markNotReadyDuringLifecycle.description: When true, flips ome.io/serving=False on the pod before the mutation so EndpointSlice drains traffic first. Controller default is true.

readyPolicy.description: How Instance-level readiness aggregates from underlying pods. Controller default for multi-pod Instances is AllPodReady.

instanceReadyTimeout.description: Go-style duration string (e.g. "30m"). Upper bound for waiting on a newly-created Instance to become Ready during migration, rollout, or initial creation. Controller default is 30m.

mode.description: Migration disposition. Controller default is auto (resolves to surge or rejection).

componentBlock.description: Scientist-facing component knobs. Hidden infrastructure (resources, tolerations, RDMA) lives in the vendor profile.

args.description: Extra CLI flags appended after the runtime base + synthesised typed flags. User entries win on duplicate `--flag` via dedup-by-flag-name. See README "Args layering".

contextLength.description: Synthesised as `--context-length <N>` on the runner args.

gpuMemoryUtilization.description: Fraction (0.0–1.0) of GPU memory the engine may use; synthesised as `--mem-fraction-static <X>` (sglang).

maxConcurrentRequests.description: Cap on in-flight requests; synthesised as `--max-running-requests <N>` (sglang).

dtype.description: Model compute dtype. Empty string omits the flag (sglang default applies); set to a known sglang value to synthesise `--dtype <value>`.

quantization.description: Model quantization scheme (e.g. modelopt_fp4, awq, gptq, fp8). Synthesised as `--quantization <value>`; empty string omits the flag.

kvCacheDtype.description: KV cache dtype. Empty string omits the flag (sglang default applies); set to a known sglang value to synthesise `--kv-cache-dtype <value>`.

moeRunnerBackend.description: MoE-only runner backend (e.g. flashinfer_trtllm). Synthesised as `--moe-runner-backend <value>`; empty string omits the flag.

engineBlock.description: Engine component knobs for standalone or multinode servingModes. workerSize only applies in multinode.

args.description: Extra CLI flags appended after the runtime base + synthesised typed flags. User entries win on duplicate `--flag` via dedup-by-flag-name. See README "Args layering".

contextLength.description: Synthesised as `--context-length <N>` on the runner args.

gpuMemoryUtilization.description: Fraction (0.0–1.0) of GPU memory the engine may use; synthesised as `--mem-fraction-static <X>` (sglang).

maxConcurrentRequests.description: Cap on in-flight requests; synthesised as `--max-running-requests <N>` (sglang).

dtype.description: Model compute dtype. Empty string omits the flag (sglang default applies); set to a known sglang value to synthesise `--dtype <value>`.

quantization.description: Model quantization scheme (e.g. modelopt_fp4, awq, gptq, fp8). Synthesised as `--quantization <value>`; empty string omits the flag.

kvCacheDtype.description: KV cache dtype. Empty string omits the flag (sglang default applies); set to a known sglang value to synthesise `--kv-cache-dtype <value>`.

moeRunnerBackend.description: MoE-only runner backend (e.g. flashinfer_trtllm). Synthesised as `--moe-runner-backend <value>`; empty string omits the flag.

workerSize.description: Number of worker pods per leader gang (multinode servingMode only).

routerBlock.description: Router component knobs (prefill+decode disaggregated servingMode). enabled=false omits the router entirely.

args.description: Extra CLI flags appended after the synthesised flags; user overrides win on duplicate flags.

timeoutSeconds.description: Request-completion deadline; synthesised as `--backend-timeout <N>` on the router runner.

streamingTimeoutSeconds.description: SSE/token-stream deadline (default 600); synthesised as `--streaming-timeout-secs <N>` (sglang router flag name may differ; see template).

envList.description: Container env vars. Forwarded onto the tenant CSR's runner.env, where they merge with the vendor profile's env list by `name` (predictable per-key strategic merge). Use either `{name, value}` for literals or `{name, valueFrom}` for downward-API / configMap / secret refs.

valueFrom.description: Standard corev1.EnvVarSource (fieldRef / resourceFieldRef / configMapKeyRef / secretKeyRef). Schema not narrowed in v0.1; OME webhook validates the rendered InferenceService.

coordinationBlock.description: Cross-Component rollout coordination. The chart synthesises one RolloutCoordinationGroup containing the Components present in this deployment.

order.description: Required when policy=Sequential. Scientist-facing names (prefill/decode/engine/router); the chart translates to OME Component names.

soak.description: Wait duration between Sequential steps; Go-style duration string (e.g. "10m").
